name: Dynamics 365 Contact Center
short_description: Microsoft's cloud contact center service for handling customer conversations across voice calls and digital channels from one agent workspace, with AI agents, routing and Copilot assistance. It can work alongside Dynamics 365 Customer Service or other CRM systems.

evidence.quote: we're looking at Dynamics 365 Contact Center in plain English
Microsoft's cloud service for handling customer conversations across phone calls and digital channels
Dynamics 365 Contact Center, that's the new name for what used to be called Omni Channel
